name: AMD/Xilinx Alveo U280 Data Center Accelerator Card Data Sheet (DS963 v1.2)
notes: DS963 v1.2, 2019-11-20. Production U280: 8 GB HBM2 at 460 GB/s, 32 GB DDR4 (two 16 GB 2400 MT/s RDIMMs) at 38 GB/s DDR total bandwidth, 225 W card load, PCIe Gen3 x16 or Gen4 x8, full-height dual-slot. Active (A-U280-A32G-DEV-G) and passive (A-U280-P32G-PQ-G) SKUs. Accessed via the Mouser-hosted copy of the Xilinx datasheet PDF.
